meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 5 — International architecture densification: China trade/FDI, Korea, Japan, ASEAN framework, additional bilateral FTAs/EPAs, and multi-vector partnership framing. Complements the USA corridor and existing CPTPP/EVFTA/RCEP nodes.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China merchandise trade statistics
candidates.description: Bilateral goods trade with China. China is Vietnam’s largest overall trading partner and dominant import source (intermediate goods, components, machinery). Vietnam runs a large structural trade deficit with China while exporting electronics, agricultural products and other goods.
candidates.notes: High-centrality bilateral trade node. China is the largest import source and second export market.

candidates.title: Vietnam–China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing
candidates.description: Highest-tier bilateral relationship (Comprehensive Strategic Partnership since 2008). Continuously referenced in trade, investment, border management and South China Sea discussions.
candidates.notes: Political-economic frame for the largest overall trade relationship.

candidates.title: Vietnam–Korea trade and FDI statistics
candidates.description: Bilateral trade and investment with the Republic of Korea. Korea is a top-three export market, major import source and consistently among the largest FDI sources (electronics, manufacturing, consumer industries).

candidates.title: Vietnam–Korea Free Trade Agreement (VKFTA)
candidates.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and Republic of Korea
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA in force since 2015. Deepens preferential access beyond the ASEAN–Korea framework and supports the large bilateral investment and trade relationship.
candidates.notes: Key bilateral FTA densification for the Korea corridor.

candidates.title: Vietnam–Japan trade and FDI statistics
candidates.description: Bilateral trade and investment with Japan. Japan is a top-five export market, important import source and long-standing major FDI partner (manufacturing, infrastructure, technology).

candidates.title: Vietnam–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (VJEPA)
candidates.description: Bilateral EPA in force since 2009. Complements the ASEAN–Japan CEP and CPTPP; covers goods, services, investment and movement of natural persons.

candidates.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Vietnamese participation)
candidates.description: Vietnam’s participation in the ASEAN Economic Community and related ASEAN+ FTAs. Continuously cited in regional trade, investment and production-network analysis.

candidates.title: UK–Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (UKVFTA)
candidates.publisher: Governments of Vietnam and the United Kingdom
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA in force since 2021 (continuity agreement after Brexit). Preserves preferential access to the UK market for Vietnamese exports.

candidates.title: Vietnam multi-vector external economic strategy framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade, FDI and partnership sources
candidates.description: System-level framing of Vietnam’s deliberately multi-aligned external economic posture: largest export market in the United States, largest import and overall trade partner in China, major FDI and technology partners in Korea and Japan, dense preferential access via CPTPP/EVFTA/RCEP, and Comprehensive Strategic Partnerships with 14 countries including all five UN Security Council permanent members.
referenced_by: All major bilateral and FTA nodes
candidates.notes: High-level organising frame for Vietnam’s external economic architecture.

candidates.title: Vietnam international-architecture densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO, MPI, customs and partnership sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Vietnam–China trade and partnership, Vietnam–Korea trade/FDI and VKFTA, Vietnam–Japan trade/FDI and VJEPA, ASEAN framework, UKVFTA, and multi-vector external strategy framing into a coherent international-architecture layer that complements the USA corridor and existing CPTPP/EVFTA/RCEP nodes.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
USA trade, CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP and FDI series from earlier batches
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the international densification pass.
